text:
- **Owner questions and answers:** Ask-tool questions can now be answered on the site as well as in chat. The first answer wins, and question endings now come only from hook events.
- **CI and test stability:** The AGENTS.md check gives the same verdict on every rerun, and the test-go target passes on every run. macOS Go jobs and full AGENTS.md grading now run once a day.
- **Repo tooling and hooks:** pm no longer installs a git hook, and each new worktree is set up at session start. Claude Code auto memory is now off in this repo, and this repo runs the newer pm release.
- **Record layer design:** The owner chose Model A, and its design page is in final form. A live check showed Claude sessions can write a nested records worktree.
